notes.title: Ship Ahoy Open BETA is NOW SUPPORTING OCULUS VR!
notes.content:
Hola a todos!!  Hope you are doing great. We are very happy to announce that our first VR Multiplayer SHIP AHOY is NOW supporting OCULUS!! 

Being an indie team it means the world to us to have your support and your help to spread the word.

Please keep sharing with us! We are still working on this game and your feedback helps us improve it. Any new ideas, bugs reports, hardware insights, everything helps!

Remember you can meet OKAM's team at SHIP AHOY's Discord channel: https://discord.gg/HzKaNSW

Looking forward for your thoughts!
